claims.text: Women: metronidazole 500 mg 2 times/day for 7 days.
claims.quote: Recommended Regimen for Trichomoniasis Among Women Metronidazole 500 mg 2 times/day for 7 days

claims.text: Men: metronidazole 2 g orally in a single dose.
claims.quote: Recommended Regimen for Trichomoniasis Among Men Metronidazole 2 g orally in a single dose

claims.text: Alternative (women and men): tinidazole 2 g orally in a single dose.
claims.quote: Alternative Regimen for Women and Men Tinidazole 2 g orally in a single dose

claims.text: Your notes (Trichomoniasis row) list metronidazole 2 g once or 500 mg BID for 7 days as equal options.
claims.quote: Metronidazole (2g x1 or 500mg BID x7d) OR Tinidazole 2g x1

claims.text: CDC now recommends the 7-day course for women; the single 2 g dose is the regimen for men.
claims.quote: Recommended Regimen for Trichomoniasis Among Women Metronidazole 500 mg 2 times/day for 7 days Recommended Regimen for Trichomoniasis Among Men Metronidazole 2 g orally in a single dose
